description: Source code for the OX_PluginExport class, part of the Revive Adserver project, handling plugin export and backup functionalities.

classes.name: OX_PluginExport
classes.description: Class responsible for exporting plugin packages, creating backups, and compressing files within the Revive Adserver system.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes plugin export by parsing package and component group data.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Resets internal state and clears error and file lists.

methods.name: _compileContents
methods.description: Compiles list of files and schemas for a given plugin package.

methods.name: exportPlugin
methods.description: Exports a plugin package by compiling contents and creating a zip archive.

methods.name: backupTables
methods.description: Creates backups of database tables associated with plugin schemas.

methods.name: _compressFiles
methods.description: Compresses collected files into a zip archive using PclZip.

methods.name: _getSchemaFiles
methods.description: Adds schema-related files to the file list.

methods.name: _getScriptFiles
methods.description: Adds script files related to plugin installation and uninstallation.

methods.name: _getChangesetFiles
methods.description: Adds change set files from the plugin's changes directory.

methods.name: _getDeclaredFiles
methods.description: Adds declared files from plugin installation data.

methods.name: _addToFileList
methods.description: Adds a file path to the internal list of files to be included in export.

methods.name: _makeDirectory
methods.description: Creates a directory with recursive option.
